note: Triennial election of Newry No. 2 (County Armagh) Rural District Council, twenty-nine single-member divisions, 1958. Nominations 20 May 1958; two withdrawals (Ballybot, Killeen); six contests, polled Thursday 5 June 1958. No nomination for Moyra Castle, whose outgoing member was deemed re-elected. Labels as printed in the Newry Telegraph. Polled Thursday 5 June 1958. The outgoing member was John Reid, J.P. (U.). A third nominee, Peter Feehan (N.), withdrew. Spoiled papers: 5. Earlier transcription: Peter Feighan was also nominated (Newry Reporter, 22 May 1958) but is not in the result. The Armagh Guardian (13 June 1958, p. 7) prints the same figures.
